page.overview:
Who is Hachidai?

Hachidai is a bald headed man with black eyes. He has a black beard and wears a simple outfit with a blue-coloured cloth tied around his shoulders and a white twisted cloth wrapped around his head tied on the right side.

He and his friends leave the village after Raiga Kurosuki overthrows the village's government. They get caught in a storm after leaving and eventually wind up in the Land of Fire, where they meet Naruto Uzumaki. Hachidai returns to Katabami Gold Mine once Naruto and other Konoha ninja are sent to investigate Raiga.
